note: Frames for the luận cung chapters (prose/luan.ts, prose-style plan S2–S4): the palace frame sentence, bold topic lead-ins, the tail of each argued paragraph (synthesis, advice, the two-edged image), Thân cư, the cung giáp / nhị hợp / lục hại positions, hậu vận and the closing. Frames name chart facts and reasoning steps only; every claim still comes from a fired rule of the palace's ReadingPlan, and the tail sentences only juxtapose what the paragraph already said (basis he_thong).
